get.description: Enforces requireAdmin RBAC guard. Serves system statistics and user role management controls.

patch.description: Updates a target user role. Demoting the last remaining administrator is rejected by invariant protection.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity: Cannot demote the last active administrator

get.description: Serves the Mintlify Aurora-styled account registration view with real-time validation.

post.description: Validates input, hashes password with bcrypt, assigns non-admin role (alumni or student), and creates user.

201.description: User registered successfully and confirmation view displayed

400.description: Validation failed or duplicate email address

post.description: Creates a new user record with bcrypt password hashing and default non-admin role.
Verifies email and password using bcrypt comparison and returns session token.
Revokes active session token and clears session cookie.

get.description: Returns profile details of the currently authenticated session or Bearer token.
Serves the login portal matching the Mintlify Aurora design system.

post.description: Authenticates user, issues 24h session token stored in an HttpOnly cookie, and redirects.

302.description: Redirect to target application view with Set-Cookie

get.description: Destroys active session, clears HttpOnly session cookie, and redirects to login.

post.description: Destroys active session, clears cookie, and redirects.

patch.description: Partially updates specific fields of an existing user via ApiUserController.

get.description: Retrieves all users via UserController. Supports HTML views (Accept: text/html) and JSON fallback.
